title: A parametric approach to defining archetypes for an integrated material stocks and flows analysis and life cycle assessment of built stocks
architecture: GIS asset geometry -> parametrized assemblies -> nested elements/materials -> mass inventory
input: Geometry; asset typology; assembly composition; dimensions; density; wastage coefficients
transformation: Rules infer assembly quantities; measured quantity multiplied by wastage coefficient; conversion to kg using material properties
output: Spatially and hierarchically resolved material mass
uncertainty_entry: Geometry limitations; inferred composition; rules of thumb; missing GIS data/defaults
propagation: No explicit probability/interval propagation reported in examined method
tracking: Asset-assembly-element-material nesting preserves where material is located; uncertainty provenance is not an implemented output
temporal_link: Replacement what-if examples; dynamic MFA/LCA enabled, not a demonstrated dated outflow forecast
validation: House and road cases; partial methodological application; no city-scale validation
proposed_addition: Attach distributions/alternatives and source IDs to geometry, composition and coefficients; preserve shared archetype dependence during mass calculation

title: Integrating Digital Twins and Material Passports for Circular Built Environment Management
architecture: Conceptual digital twin + material passport platform
input: Composition, provenance, reuse potential and dynamic asset data
transformation: Integration proposed; operational mapping not verified
tracking: Material provenance discussed; uncertainty tracking not established
proposed_addition: Do not infer an implemented uncertainty mechanism before obtaining full text

title: Method Development for the Quantification of Urban Mining Potentials at District Level
architecture: Semantic CityGML + material/component databases -> filtered component alternatives -> synthetic mean components -> layer service lives -> yearly outflow CSV
input: Building type/year/roof/areas;1134component alternatives;layer thickness,density,material fractions,reference service life
transformation: m=A*d*rho*alpha; alternatives averaged into synthetic component; layer mass assigned to replacement years and aggregated by year/material
output: 46material-group stocks, replacement-year masses and scenario/recycling outputs
uncertainty_entry: Unobserved construction alternatives; LoD2 hidden parts; assumed lifetimes; synchronized renovation/demolition scenarios
uncertainty_representation: Alternative designs averaged; deterministic reference service lives and scenarios, not probability distributions
propagation: Mass and dates transferred, but no explicit probabilistic uncertainty propagation; averaging alternatives discards their dispersion
tracking: Building/component/material grouping and year-specific CSV rows; no uncertainty ledger demonstrated
temporal_link: Direct B23: layer mass linked to service life/replacement year;50year scenarios and100year demolition/rebuild scenario
validation: German district model; authors acknowledge synchronized interventions, replacement dependency and censored>=50year lifetimes as limitations
proposed_addition: Preserve alternative components/weights rather than mean alone; condition remaining life on age and interventions; carry common realization IDs into annual flows; validate event timing

title: The digital twin on a residential housing in the Czech Republic on the BIM platform and its importance for the circular economy
architecture: Manual survey -> Archicad28 -> classified floor/element BIM -> material and reusable-component inventory
transformation: Elements and layered structures assigned geometry and properties; counts and masses tabulated
output: Identified reusable components and material quantities
uncertainty_entry: Insufficient original documentation; condition and reuse suitability
uncertainty_representation: No explicit stochastic uncertainty representation found in target transformation
tracking: Building/element identification, floor location, coordinates and classification
temporal_link: Residual life/reuse discussed; no calibrated probabilistic outflow time series demonstrated
validation: Single residential case; reuse needs condition/safety verification
proposed_addition: Maintain measured versus inferred attributes and condition evidence; propagate quantity and reuse-status uncertainty separately

title: Integrated BIM-GIS framework for holistic building stock assessment using 5D geo-modeling and digital twin concepts
architecture: Handheld scan -> FARO -> E57 -> Recap/RCP -> manual Revit LOD300 -> material intensity -> GIS volume/change detection
input: Visible geometry; site observations; analogous BOQs; literature densities; GIS volume
transformation: Element volume*density -> floor mass; MI=mass/gross volume; intensity mapped to GIS gross volumes
output: Material mass/intensity and spatial demolition-waste potential
uncertainty_entry: Hidden foundations excluded; composition not experimentally tested; one scanned archetype; imagery/height and manual tracing errors
uncertainty_representation: Qualitative limitations and project-specific volume correction factor 1.01
propagation: No explicit distribution/covariance propagation; calibration factor is not an uncertainty distribution
tracking: Material and floor location; multi-temporal demolition observations 2021-2024
temporal_link: Retrospective demolition change detection; no prospective probabilistic lifetime model demonstrated
validation: 23-building study area but only one building scanned; full district extrapolation not implemented (section5)
proposed_addition: Carry quantity uncertainty and archetype variability to GIS; attach event-time uncertainty to demolition observations; do not treat all23 as independent scans

title: AI-Aided Non-Visual Object Sensing and Replicating for Digital Transformations
architecture: Phone vibration/microphone -> audio preprocessing -> Mel spectrogram -> CNN material classification
transformation: Normalized frames -> STFT/Mel features -> predicted class
uncertainty_representation: Accuracy/F1/confusion matrix; not calibrated per-object uncertainty
propagation: No material-class uncertainty propagated to density/mass or stock flows
tracking: Real-time material inference; no complete building inventory lineage demonstrated
validation: 900 samples; one object per class; 91% controlled test accuracy, about75.4% plateau in noisy duration experiment
proposed_addition: Calibrate class probabilities on independent objects, retain alternative materials and propagate class-dependent density into inventory

title: Towards a structural condition assessment framework for selective reuse
architecture: Structural condition assessment system within BIM workflow
transformation: Condition information to material inventory for selective reuse
tracking: BIM condition recording, per abstract; future DT development
temporal_link: Reuse viability rather than explicit timed outflow model
validation: Case study per abstract; claims LOD below500 adequate
proposed_addition: Full-text verification needed before treating condition assessment as remaining-life uncertainty update

title: An Integrated BIM-AI Framework for Intelligent Cost Management
architecture: BIM/document NLP and CV extraction -> cost features -> regression/RF/ANN -> cost/design scenarios
input: Quantities/specifications/design variables and historical/market cost data
transformation: Extracted quantities feed cost predictions and sensitivity scenarios
output: Predicted cost ranges and material alternatives
uncertainty_entry: Extraction omissions/bias; design and market variation
uncertainty_representation: Cost range and prediction-error metrics; no verified material-inventory probability continuity
tracking: Design-cost relations and feature importance; lifecycle DT integration remains prospective
validation: Single350m2project; authors explicitly report no ground-truth precision/recall/IoU for NLP/CV extraction
proposed_addition: Validate quantity extraction first; distinguish prediction intervals from scenario ranges; do not transfer cost uncertainty claims to material mass

title: Data fusion approach for a digital construction logistics twin
architecture: BIM/4D + specifications/BoQ + BMEcat catalogue -> GTIN/schema mapping -> SQL/geometry server -> WebAPI/mobile app
input: Component quantities, product/pack attributes, storage and planned installation dates
transformation: Link building elements to trade items; group packages and assign storage/delivery/installation
uncertainty_entry: Missing/non-specific product identity; absent GTIN; stale planning; manual entry
uncertainty_representation: No quantitative uncertainty objects in implemented data model
propagation: Material/data fusion demonstrated; uncertainty propagation not demonstrated
tracking: GTIN and unique package IDs; mobile QR/status capture; sensor-network automatic updates explicitly unsupported
temporal_link: Construction deliveries/installation, not building demolition lifetimes
validation: Demonstrator SQL database, management tool and mobile visualization; no uncertainty calibration benchmark
proposed_addition: Extend linked entities with source/version/time, uncertain quantity and event-time attributes; distinguish status updates from uncertainty updates

title: Bridging BIM and Stochastic Simulation: A Conceptual Framework and Illustrative Application
architecture: Revit -> Dynamo -> governed Excel -> COSMOS discrete-event simulation -> Synchro4D/EVA -> corrective re-simulation
input: Deterministic BIM quantity Q; random productivity P; resource/network constraints
transformation: D=Q/P; triangular productivity sampled by Monte Carlo; durations feed constrained schedule
uncertainty_entry: Operational productivity; quantity measurement noise acknowledged as future work
uncertainty_representation: Illustrative triangular distributions;1000MonteCarlo runs; P50/P80 schedule outputs
propagation: Explicit productivity-to-duration/schedule propagation; Q is held deterministic, so S1 uncertainty does not continue through it
tracking: UniqueId+WBS+SI units, range/field/ID validation and versioned parameter store; SPI<0.90 triggers update
temporal_link: Construction activity duration analogue; not stock lifetime/demolition probability
validation: Illustrative proof of concept, not field-validated; complete activity-level production reproducibility not provided
proposed_addition: Extend contract with uncertainty/dependence/source fields and replace duration logic with conditioned stock-turnover model for B23

title: Circular economy and virtual reality in advanced BIM‐based prefabricated construction
architecture: BIM + BoQ -> Unity VR representation of materials and disassembly
transformation: Link inventory to visual material-bank and disassembly information
output: Material/component visibility and CE learning environment
uncertainty_entry: Unknown composition/design life for some new products
uncertainty_representation: Acknowledged knowledge gaps; no probability model in bridge
tracking: Visual material provenance/stock; no uncertainty history demonstrated
temporal_link: End-of-life/disassembly representation, not timed outflow forecast
validation: Singlepurpose-built CE demonstrator; unknown product performance noted in limitations
proposed_addition: Expose unknown service life explicitly in inventory and link later evidence to versioned lifetime assumptions

title: Integrated Embodied-Operational Carbon Reduction for Sustainable Egyptian Housing Through Wall-System Substitution
location: Methods BIM material quantification; section4.2 limitations; replacement assumptions
architecture: CAD/BIM quantities -> FEM and energy simulation -> substitution/carbon scenarios
input: Material quantities, density, structural loads, emission factors, service assumptions
transformation: Density/material substitution changes dead load and structural quantities and energy demand
output: Revised material requirements and embodied/operational carbon
uncertainty_entry: Proxy emission factors; quantity assumptions; replacement and service-life assumptions
uncertainty_representation: Scenario/sensitivity comparison; no calibrated stock-flow uncertainty distribution established
propagation: Deterministic cross-model consequences; probability propagation not demonstrated
tracking: Coordinated architectural/structural model; no uncertainty lineage layer shown
temporal_link: 60-year assessment with defined replacement events; not stochastic retirement model
validation: Two housing designs; A1-A3 plus selectedreplacement/operation boundary, end-of-life broadly excluded
proposed_addition: Keep scenario/model uncertainty distinct from random input uncertainty and preserve dependencies when structural redesign changes quantities

title: Acquiring Semantic Information of Precast Concrete Pipe Using Geometric Feature Extraction from Mobile Laser Scanning Point Cloud
architecture: Mobile laser point cloud -> FPFH/RANSAC/ICP -> geometric validation -> georeferenced BIM objects
input: Sparse/occluded one-sided scans and pipe reference model
transformation: Feature matching and cylinder/normal checks produce count/location/orientation
output: Detected precast-pipe inventory with timestamps and coordinates
uncertainty_entry: Occlusion, sparse points, object matching and registration
uncertainty_representation: Observed detection/location errors; not per-object probabilistic covariance
propagation: No explicit detection uncertainty -> quantity/mass uncertainty calculation
tracking: Timestamp prevents confusion between successive scans; object position enables BIM placement
temporal_link: Site material state; no retirement-time model
validation: 11of14pipes detected; average coordinate difference0.75m; single site
proposed_addition: Retain false-negative/misassociation uncertainty; propagate count and geometry error instead of equating undetected with absent

title: Why Has LOD3 Not Scaled? From Reconstruction Algorithms to the Generation of 3D City Models
architecture: Oblique imagery -> AI facade candidates -> human correction/QA -> semantic CityGMLLOD3
input: Images and existing city-model production workflow
transformation: Operator-validated facade/roof semantics exported as city model
uncertainty_entry: Visibility, reconstruction, semantic interpretation and maintenance
uncertainty_representation: Workflow QA and qualified limitations; no mass/flow uncertainty distribution
propagation: No executed material inventory uncertainty propagation
tracking: Human validation and semantic object retention; detailed uncertainty lineage not demonstrated
temporal_link: Model maintenance discussed; no stock-flow model
validation: Production pilot; effort reductions indicative, not controlled accuracy benchmark
